notablePrerequisites: At least two nontoken creatures have died under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Caller of the Claw.
Caller of the Claw enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token for each nontoken creature that has died under your control this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two 2/2 Bear creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
